text: City Council on June 25 and 26, 2025, adopted Item IE22.2 as amended and, in so doing, has requested the Toronto Parking Authority board to request the President, Toronto Parking Authority, in consultation with the Director, Equity and Human Rights, to report in the first quarter of 2026 on the feasibility of extending free parking at other times of religious significance in addition to Sunday mornings.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority withdrew Item PA16.17 from the agenda.
